items.scope: plan T1: feasibility spike for two models/proxy/PTC/TUI/resume
plan T4: live-ptc.mjs and fix if needed
plan T6: review of production fixes of this run
plan T7: docs, full tests, budget, push

decisions.what: T1 outcome: T2, T3, T4 go ahead with the spike's recipes; T5 (TUI) is blocked
decisions.why: docs/iterations/1-spike.md: Q1 two sessions on different models in one dsh web is possible (UI pick + HTTP RPC session/create, session/selectModel, session/prompt); Q2 resume = --session-id with an agent-default-model overlay; Q3 dsh-tool-search overlay gives tool_search/tool_call; Q4 PTC = tools entry config mode ptc, nested bash is NOT in the spool (only run_code), Q5 this dsh install has no TUI profile (dsh tui: profile tui does not exist), so D5 cannot be met here and the DoD is frozen

decisions.what: Watch item for T2: before a web session's first request the route is agent.options (profile default), not the model chosen by session/selectModel
decisions.why: spike Q1: endpoint reply for B said haiku after selectModel(sonnet) until the first request. T2 measures it, and fixes it only if DSH emits an event carrying the selection; otherwise it is documented as a limit (the call runs on the default model, never on another session's)

decisions.what: T4 fix direction for PTC: the spool must not make a tool used from run_code look unused
decisions.why: spike Q4: spool has only the run_code block, but PostToolUse reached the plugin for the nested bash first; the core would see an MCP tool used only through the SDK as never used and propose denying it
